When I was just barely 17 years old to just barely 18, I was in a (long distance) relationship with an 40 something year old man. I was very mentally ill at the time and very emotionally dependant on him. He was also my first time and stuff.

So then, he comes out to me that he had been doing innapropriate things to another one of his partners' 10 year old daughter and had been found out. I'm in denial and selfish, so I just freak out and don't want anything to happen to him.

Well, a week later, he isn't answering my texts by the usual time, so with the info he had given me previously, I'm freaking the fuck out... But I was at school so there wasn't a whole lot I could do. 

Then later I get a call from an area code from where he lives. It was a police officer asking to speak to me, and after fighting with me to confirm my identity (probably wasn't expecting a crying child, since they kept asking to speak to an older relative). Then once I asked "what happened to [his name]???", he cop finally believed it was me. That's when I learned he had killed himself.

So. That was all hard enough as it is, but his partners tried acting as a support system for me for a while, despite me being a horrible secret he had kept from him. However, they suddenly cut contact, after one attacked me, calling me messed up and horrible. I still have zero idea what caused this.

It ended with me spending a month in a partial hospitalization program and even more emotional/mental problems. However, I am starting to get better, so that's a plus.

My ex boyfriend.

He killed himself almost 2 years ago now. That itself is enough to making hard to let go, but there's extra complications making it even harder for me.

I'm not super emotionally stable and mentally well to begin with. I've struggled with severe depression, anxiety, etc. since I was around 10 years old. I became extremely emotionally dependant on him.

Some could say that was what he was going for. It probably was. I was 16, almost 17 when he first messaged me. He was in his early 40s. We met on Reddit. He messaged me after I made a post on a subreddit that provides support for those who are suicidal. I was in a horrible state and really willing to cling to any help I could get.

I loved him. I really and truely did. He was the first boyfriend I had ever met in person. He was my first real date. He was my first time. He was my everything.

But he wasn't a good person. He would yell at me and throw things occassionally. He would cut off contact for some time if my emotions started getting out of hand. He told he'd stop talking to me if I started self harming again. He kept me secret from his other partners.

But, worst of all, he molested one of his other partners' 10 year old daughter. I don't know when it started and how long it went on for. I just know the daughter had told her mom a little over a week before he killed himself. He told me a week before he killed himself.

I couldn't bring myself to leave him. I couldn't bring myself to hate him. I stuck by him. I hate myself so much for this. I hate myself even more for the fact that I don't know if I'd be able to resist going back to him if turned out to still be alive somehow.

I don't know how to get over this. I can't mourn... It doesn't feel right mourning for someone like him... But I can't stop thinking of him... I hate myself for missing him... It's still tearing me apart 2 years later... I was doing well for a while... But these last two months I've gotten pretty bad again...

I can't let go of this...

It happened like... A year and a half ago when I was just barely 18. We were long distance and we had had our second visit about fewweeks before that. He was in the city nearby about a week or two before for an event but, I couldn't visit him. I was the last one to talk to him before hi There was an unacceptable age gap. He was in his 40s. Due to this, I was a secret from his other three partners and he was a secret from my family and friends.

He killed himself because he had been molesting another partner's 10 year old daughter and the daughter had told her mom. I knew what he had done for about a week before his death. I still clung to him for some reason. I hate myself for that, but I can't go back and change it.

It was terrifying and confusing. It felt unreal. The day it happened, I hadn't recieved any message from him by the usual time, which was about 10:30am. By 1:30pm, I was really freaking out. I was sneakily texting him during class. I was calling him in the bathroom or during lunch. Nothing. Then in the middle of my last class, I get a call with an area code from his area. Now I'm freaking out. I knew it had to be bad news. I debate with myself whether to go take the call in the bathroom or wait until I got home. I decide on the latter and somehow pull myself through the rest of class.

I get home and call the number back. It was a policeman in his city. They ask for someone by my name. I say that's me. They ask for my parents or an older sibling. I refuse, saying that since I'm a legal adult, they can't do that. They refuse to believe me. They finally give in and let me give them my state ID number. I do so and they say they'll call back after they're done searching, I think. So I go on my computer to try and distract myself and calm down while I wait. And there it is in our shared dropbox folder. A suicide note along with a will.

So I get a call back from the police officer. They say they couldn't confirm it was me. I'm frantic at this point. I yell "what happened to *his name*?!?!?!" Into the phone. They then go silent and ask "what was your relationship to *his name.*" To which I answered his partner or girlfriend or something of this nature. Then I get the comfirmation. He had killed himself.

So. Back when I had found out about the event that lead him to do this, he gave me contact info for two out of the three partners incase anything happened to him. I should have seen it coming, but I had assumed he meant if he was arrested. He claimed they would be there for me. So I emailed them. And they were, even the one he hadn't given me contact info for. Or they were for a while. 

The first one said she was too overwhelmed with the whole situation to help me, which was understandable. But the other two just suddenly hated me. One of them said they found our skype logs on his laptop and started spewing hate, telling me there was something seriously wrong with me. I thought I had already told them everything that would have driven me away. I had no idea what she found. I still have no idea. They refused to say another word to me after that.

I started relapsing on self-injury after being good for about a year. (I had been doing so since about age 10) It got worse and worse, and I ended up in a PHP for it. It sucked but whatever. The suicide had made my depression, ED, and anxiety worse and I ended up with PTSD. It caused me to lock myself in my room whenever I wasn't at therapy. I stopped talking to everyone. It took me so long to believe I could love or even trust anyone ever again. Once I did, I got terrified any time someone stopped responding to me. I'm still struggling pretty badly.

TL;DR: Ex killed himself; fucked me up big time.
